title.narrative: UN Women-Women, Peace and Security and Shaml

description.narrative:
Support to UN Women to implement the program “Reclaiming Power: Advancing Gender Justice and Women’s Leadership for Sustainable Peace and Recovery in Palestine”. The WPS new three-year program in the West Bank and Gaza Strip seeks to institutionalize and scale up women’s leadership in peace and security, humanitarian action, and recovery. It aligns with the Humanitarian-Development-Peace Nexus (HDPN), the Sustainable Development Goals (particularly SDG 5 and SDG 16), and Norway’s Fifth National Action Plan on WPS. The proposed intervention aligns with UN Women’s Global Strategic Plan (2022-2025) and Strategic Note for Palestine (2022-2025 – extended until 2027).
The second component will be targeting the furthest left behind. The component will focus on two main pillars: 1. Inclusive Protection Systems: Strengthening the national protection framework to respond effectively and sensitively to the needs of the most marginalized women specifically women with disabilities, sex workers, women users of drugs, and LGBTQ+ women who are routinely excluded from mainstream support. 2. Empowerment and Leadership: Enabling these women to actively participate in humanitarian response and governance, with a focus on recovery and peacebuilding. This includes leadership development, advocacy, and civic engagement.
These pillars aim to ensure both protection and meaningful inclusion and participation of those most left behind in crisis and recovery efforts.
